crop.notes: the Allen item (top) is complete; the clipping also includes an unrelated 'Lexington Races' dispatch below it

ocr.notes: stakes are $5,000 or less, not $500; dateline 'New York, May 17' omitted; race times slightly off

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican printed a New York dispatch that Tom Allen, admitting his defeat by Jem Mace near New Orleans, challenged all professional fighters except Mace and Heenan for $5,000 or less, hoping Coburn would accept.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, May 18, 1870'; dispatch dated New York, May 17

facts.fact: Allen admitted his defeat by Jem Mace in their fight near New Orleans
From New York, Allen challenged all professional fighters except Mace and Heenan to fight for $5,000 or less, particularly wanting Coburn to accept
Allen signed his challenge as champion of America by Mace's permission
facts.quote: champion of America, by permission of Mr. James Mace, champion of the world

notes: Dispatch is datelined New York; it does not say Allen himself was in New York. Coburn and Heenan first names not printed.
